screen.scope: Indexed polygon bounds and triangle contact vertices, both quad diagonals with every mixed triangle pairing, 1e-9 length tolerance. Contacts are allowed only on common topological vertices/edges (4e-9 boundary tolerance). Floating-point screen; degeneracy and manifold checks are separate.

scope: Retained actual exports evaluated under all combinations of quad diagonals, with independent strict-interior LP witnesses for reported face pairs. This screen uses floating-point tolerances; witness absence does not clear boundary contacts or unresolved programs.
